12.t: Working with data: carbon in different forms
q: Explain why diamond is used on drill tips.
It is the hardest (10): each carbon is bonded to four others in a rigid giant structure.
Explain why graphite conducts but diamond does not.
In graphite each carbon uses only three electrons in bonds; the fourth is delocalised and can move. Diamond has no free electrons.
C₆₀ melts far lower than diamond and graphite. Explain using structure.
C₆₀ is made of separate molecules held by weak forces; diamond and graphite are giant covalent structures where strong bonds must break.
